summaries: The {item} went missing somewhere in {location}. Find it and bring it back.
Someone left the {item} behind in {location} and won't go back for it. You might.
clues: A letter, never sent: "I hid the {item} in {location}. Whoever finds this, take it to the harbour."

items.name: Harbourmaster's Ledger
items.description: Its pages are stuck together with salt, but the figures are legible.

items.name: Saint's Reliquary
items.description: A little tin box with a knucklebone inside, wrapped in faded silk.

items.name: Brass Sextant
items.description: Green with verdigris, its mirror cracked, its arc still true.

items.name: Smuggler's Tally
items.description: A knotted cord, each knot a debt. Several people would pay to see it burned.

items.name: Drowned Bell
items.description: A ship's bell no bigger than a fist. It doesn't ring, though the clapper moves.
